title: Nuevo Laredo: Municipal Job Board Lists Openings at 29 Companies
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal job board is connecting job seekers with openings at 29 companies, with in-person help weekdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Centro Cívico Municipal.
content:
Nuevo Laredo job seekers have a new round of openings to pursue. The city's municipal job board, the Bolsa de Empleo Municipal, is listing vacancies at 29 companies across several sectors, the Government of Nuevo Laredo announced Nov. 21.

The program is run in coordination with the city's economic development department and matches people looking for work with employers that have openings, concentrating the listings in one place so residents can compare options without tracking down each company on their own.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal said giving families access to jobs is a priority of her administration, and the city keeps working to bring employers and job seekers together so more households can get ahead.

The weekly job board includes employers such as MEXLOG, Soriana, S-Mart, Little Caesars, Carl's Jr., Totalplay, Ryder, Robertshaw and Omnibus de México, among others, spanning retail, food service, logistics, transport and manufacturing.

Earlier editions of the related "Empleo en tu Colonia" program have offered more than 200 openings in a single day, and the job board and the National Employment Service have together placed more than 300 people in jobs, according to the city.

Anyone interested in a vacancy can go to the Bolsa de Empleo offices at the Centro Cívico Municipal, window 1, at the corner of Héroe de Nacataz and Reynosa, Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m., where staff will guide them and connect them directly with the employer. Information is also available by phone at 867 713 70 11 and on the weekly board at bolsadeempleo.com.mx.

Sources: Gobierno de Nuevo Laredo, Nov. 21, 2026; Oficina de Corresponsales, Nov. 21, 2026.
